item.title: Netanyahu to Iranians: ‘Moment of truth is near, freeing Iran depends on you’
item.description: PM says Israeli strikes in the war’s first week hit Iranian leadership figures, nuclear and military sites, weapons factories and missile launchers, adds that Israel has gained near-complete control of Tehran’s skies

item.title: Israel strikes national oil depots in Tehran for first time in war with Iran
item.description: The attack was carried out under directives from the political leadership and with IDF support, marking a significant escalation in Israel’s campaign against Iranian regime infrastructure

item.title: Iran continues to fire missiles at Israel as IDF destroys IRGC aircraft used to supply proxies
item.description: Military said it had intercepted more than 110 drones launched from Iran toward Israel since the start of the operation; Hezbollah expanded rocket fire toward communities in the Galilee

item.title: Israel strikes western Iran to provide air support to Kurdish militias ahead of possible incursion, report says
item.description: Sources tell Reuters Israel targeted areas in western Iran to support Iranian Kurdish militias based in Iraqi Kurdistan that may attempt to seize border towns; the groups are estimated to have fewer than 8,000 fighters armed mainly with light weapons

item.title: Israel confirms special forces search in Lebanon for Ron Arad clues but finds no evidence
item.description: The IDF says special forces operated overnight in eastern Lebanon searching for clues about missing navigator Ron Arad but found no remains; Lebanese officials report 29 killed in airstrikes as Hezbollah claimed clashes with Israeli forces

item.title: Iran and Hezbollah launched coordinated missile attack to overwhelm Israeli air defenses, IDF says
item.description: In recent days, the number of missiles fired toward Israel from Iran has declined compared with the early days of the war; at the same time, rocket and drone launches by Hezbollah from Lebanon have increased

item.title: Trump: Iran ‘loser of the Middle East,’ will be ‘hit very hard today’; IDF downs 110 drones since start of war
item.description: President Donald Trump says Iran has 'apologized and surrendered' after US and Israeli strikes; sirens sounded across northern Israel, and Defense Minister Israel Katz warned Lebanon will pay a heavy price over Hezbollah attacks

item.title: Iran launches barrage; drone found at Nahariya hospital parking lot as CENTCOM says 3,000 targets hit
item.description: Millions in central Israel rushed to shelters three times overnight as sirens sounded across the country; US military says more than 3,000 targets hit in Iran during first week of war; Trump: 'Two sets of their leaders are gone'

item.title: דיווח: ישראל תקפה במערב איראן כדי לתמוך במיליציות כורדיות שעשויות לפלוש
item.description: גורמים ששוחחו עם רויטרס טוענים שהמטרה היא לסייע לקבוצות בכורדיסטן העיראקית לתפוס שטח איראני לאורך הגבול. ישראל וצה"ל לא הגיבו לדברים. על פי הערכות, המיליציות כוללות פחות מ-8,000 איש החמושים בנשק קל בלבד

item.title: המלחמה כולה עטופה בסמליות היסטורית
item.description: המערכה בין ישראל לאיראן, והמעורבות היוונית שנגררה בעקבותיה, לא רק שהוציאה מהארכיון נרטיבים עתיקים – היא הפכה אותם לכלי מלחמה פעיל
